items.name: c11
items.prompt: Handcrafted miniature diorama, tilt-shift shallow depth of field, soft practical lighting, stop-motion-like gentle movement. The giant isopod keeps its exact shape: pale lilac segmented armored shell, flat triangular eyes, short antennae, seven pairs of legs, fan tail — never changes anatomy or size. Top-down view into the roofless dollhouse workroom. The long metal tongs slowly lower the small silver fish into the glass tank; the fish settles on the bottom in front of the giant isopod, which moves toward it. Keep every object's shape, material and scale unchanged. No text, no letters, no new creatures. A single continuous 4-second shot. No dialogue, no music. Avoid: text, letters, watermark, logo, extra legs, deformed anatomy, round bulging eyes, split screen, collage, realistic humans, giant scale, gore.
